description:
Find places for an intent near a location

The core call. Give one or more category ids (from `list_categories`; all must match) and a location — either
an `area_id` from `list_areas` or coordinates with a radius — and get places ranked by Atly's score for those
categories, each with quotable reasons from real reviews, a link to cite, and freshness when known. Scores are 0–10 and
relative to the area; a place with no score is unmeasured, not bad. If no place matches every category, trailing
categories are dropped until something does (the first is never dropped), and `dropped_categories` says which.
Ranking considers the strongest 100 candidates by Atly's base score. Scores are relative to other places in the same country.

area_id.description: An id from `list_areas`; the search covers that area's viewport. A city name also works ("Austin", "Boise, ID"): it resolves to the matching area, or, for a city with no area, to the extent of the places whose address is in it; the response's `area` and doc_notes say what it resolved to. Give this or lat/lon, not both.

categories.description: Category ids, most important first. Every result matches all of them (after any relaxation).

limit.description: Places to return, at most 25; a larger value returns 25.

place_type.description: Optional. Keep only places whose Google place type contains one of these words, matched as whole words: "restaurant" keeps "Mexican restaurant" and "Pizza restaurant", "coffee" keeps "Coffee shop", "bar" keeps "Wine bar" but not "Barber shop". A place matches on its main type (`place_type` in results) or any of its other Google types. Use it when the user asks for a kind of venue ("gluten-free restaurants"), not a dish or a feature. Google's types are literal: "Cafe" and "Coffee shop" are different, so for cafes pass both ["cafe", "coffee"]. The filter is applied to the strongest 400 places for the categories and never relaxed.

name: search_places

anyOf.description: The resolved search geometry — an area (id, name, level, center, bbox), a city known only from its places (name, level, region, country, center, bbox; no id), or a circle (center, radius_km).

area.description: The resolved search geometry — an area (id, name, level, center, bbox), a city known only from its places (name, level, region, country, center, bbox; no id), or a circle (center, radius_km).

anyOf.description: Category ids dropped to avoid an empty result.

dropped_categories.description: Category ids dropped to avoid an empty result.

anyOf.description: Present only for places with a gluten-free identity.

gluten_free.description: Present only for places with a gluten-free identity.

last_updated.description: When Atly last refreshed this place's data from its sources. Absent when unknown; never the date the place was added.

anyOf.description: Short first-person statements from real reviews, most useful first. Quote them.

reasons.description: Short first-person statements from real reviews, most useful first. Quote them.

score.description: Atly score 0–10 — for the requested categories in search

url.description: Canonical Atly page. Link it when you cite.
